title: Pricing Methodology — The Household Rate for an Added Residential Gas Premise
content:
For a premise added under Residential Natural Gas Supply by a customer who holds a home agreement, the household rate is the home agreement's contract rate, carried at four decimal places. It is stated in US dollars per therm and rounded half up to four decimal places.

### Input and its record

| Quantity | Where it is read |
|---|---|
| Home agreement's contract rate | the contract rate per therm on the record of the customer's gas agreement at the premise of the mailing address, in US dollars to four decimal places |

### Worked figure (hypothetical home agreement)

The home agreement carries a contract rate of 0.7480 per therm. The household rate for the added premise is 0.7480 per therm.

### In short

The home agreement's contract rate in, the household rate out, at four decimal places.
